einstellungen.text: Twelve twenty-four. Your bus comes to a stop on top of the dam.
A narrow road along the wall. On the left, a steep drop. On the right, the lake, black and still.
The doors open. Wet footprints lead from the seat next to you to the door.
Henrik stands up and straightens his jacket. Like before an inspection.
“He wants me to come with him. I left him behind that night.”
Henrik walks to the door. Outside, only fog and water.
In the window, Paul is standing by the door. But he doesn't step out.
He's looking at the stop button again. Just like before.
A ticket that was never stamped. A word on the window: stop.
Paul doesn't want to take Henrik. He only wants what he didn't get back then.
For someone to stop for him.
You stand up. Your fingers are ice cold. You press the stop button.
Up front, the red stop light glows. A bright chime. The sign flips back: Millbrook Lane.
Henrik turns around. He sees the light. He sees you. His eyes fill with tears.
In the window, Paul lifts his head. For the first time, he looks at you.
Henrik gives you a nod. Then he opens the door and steps outside.
